fullTextZH: 今天我要告诉你，我以前做过的一件坏事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you about a bad thing I did before.

fullTextZH: 我小的时候，和爷爷奶奶住在一起。
fullTextEN: When I was little, I lived with my grandparents.

fullTextZH: 我的爷爷奶奶有一间水果店，
fullTextEN: My grandparents had a fruit shop,
At that time, I was 6 years old,

fullTextZH: 我会去桌子偷拿爷爷奶奶的钱。
fullTextEN: I would go to the table to steal my grandparents' money.

fullTextZH: 我没有问爷爷奶奶：“我可以拿钱吗？”
fullTextEN: I didn't ask my grandparents, "Can I take the money?"

fullTextZH: 我拿了钱，也不告诉他们，
fullTextEN: I took the money and didn't tell them,
I know this is very bad.
Why would a 6-year-old child steal money?
because I want to give it to someone.
I want to give it to a monk.
At that time, there was a monk,
He often sat on the road.
In front of him was a bowl.
Sometimes, someone would give him money,
he didn't even say thank you,

fullTextZH: 我看到他的碗里没有钱，
fullTextEN: I saw there was no money in his bowl,
because he had no money today.
but I knew where there was money.

fullTextZH: 所以，我去爷爷奶奶的桌子拿了10块钱，放到和尚的碗里。
fullTextEN: So, I went to my grandparents' table, took 10 yuan, and put it in the monk's bowl.
He didn't say thank you either,

fullTextZH: 所以，如果我看到他的碗里没有钱，
fullTextEN: So, if I saw there was no money in his bowl,

fullTextZH: 我就去爷爷奶奶的桌子拿钱给这个和尚。
fullTextEN: I would go to my grandparents' table to take money for this monk.

fullTextZH: 你猜猜，我的爷爷奶奶发现我偷拿钱了吗？
fullTextEN: Guess what, did my grandparents find out I was taking money?

fullTextZH: 后来，这个和尚他不来了，
fullTextEN: Later, this monk didn't come anymore,

fullTextZH: “我拿了你和爷爷的钱给这个和尚。”
fullTextEN: "I took your and Grandpa's money and gave it to this monk."

fullTextZH: 但是我们想看你什么时候会告诉我们。”
fullTextEN: but we wanted to see when you would tell us."

fullTextZH: 你小的时候，也做过奇怪的事情吗？
fullTextEN: When you were little, did you also do strange things?

fullTextZH: 你为什么要做这件事情呢？
fullTextEN: Why did you do this thing?

fullTextZH: 请你也分享你的故事吧！
